name: Strategy Suite Example
description: Example external strategy plugin package covering selection, alpha, rebalance, risk, and execution.

extensions.name: External Static Selection
extensions.description: Selects the first N symbols from the configured universe.

extensions.name: External Semantic Alpha
extensions.description: Emits buy signals on ticks and semantic model outputs during evaluation.

extensions.name: External Fixed Rebalance
extensions.description: Converts plugin alpha signals into fixed-size target positions.

extensions.name: External Cap Risk
extensions.description: Caps absolute targets above a configured limit.

extensions.name: External Host Execution
extensions.description: Routes execution intents through the host execution port.
